name: Cursed Cacophony

targets.description: a creature you are familiar with on the same plane of existence

params.resave: first failed D20 Test each turn, straight roll

summary: A creature you know on your plane makes a Wis save or is cursed for up to 10 minutes: Disadvantage on D20 Tests; its first failed D20 Test each turn lets it save again.
text: You focus on a creature you are familiar with that is on the same plane of existence as you. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw or is cursed for the duration. While cursed it hears haunting, discordant music and has Disadvantage on D20 Tests. The first time on a turn that the cursed creature fails a D20 Test, it repeats the save against this spell with neither Advantage nor Disadvantage, ending the spell early on a success. Once a target fails its save against this spell you cannot target it with a ritual casting of the spell for 24 hours. Casting time: Action or Ritual. Range: special (see the creature named, however far, in the same world). Concentration, up to 10 minutes.
